headline: Is Oracle (ORCL) Using Google’s Gemini Tie-Up To Reframe Its Core AI Investment Narrative?
summary: In late July 2026, Oracle and Google Cloud expanded their partnership to bring Google's Gemini models into Oracle's Fusion Applications, NetSuite, and AI Agent Studio, broadening enterprise access to generative AI tools across Oracle's software and cloud portfolio. This move deepens Oracle's multi-model AI approach, giving customers more choice and potentially tightening the link between Oracle's core business applications and advanced AI capabilities.
